cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Absolutely, I'll help move your boxes downstairs. Help means saving effort; I'll call the lift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's broken. Carry that box yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Certainly. Yourself means without involving you. I'll hire a mover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll carry them if you hold the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Holding means preventing movement. I'll wedge the door open and supervise from this chair.
